# EPS Pros

> > EPS Pros delivers expert HR training, workplace investigations, consulting, and expert testimony services led by employment law attorneys and certified HR professionals nationwide.

EPS Pros is a 25+ year-old firm specializing in employment law compliance, workplace investigations following ISO/TS 37008 standards, and HR consulting for Fortune 100+ companies. The firm operates nationwide with regional consultants and serves management, HR professionals, and in-house counsel.

## Key Topics

- Employment Law
- Workplace Investigations
- HR Consulting
- Expert Witness Testimony
- Harassment & Discrimination
- Complaint Investigations
- ISO/TS 37008 Standards
- Title IX
- Return-to-Office Policy
- Labor Relations
- Immigration Policy
- AI Impact on HR
- Gap Analysis
- SHRM-SCP Certification
- SPHR Certification

## Core Services

- [Services](https://www.epspros.com/services): EPS core services: training, investigations, testimony, HR consulting
- [Train](https://www.epspros.com/services/train): Customized training by licensed employment law attorneys and HR pros
- [Investigate](https://www.epspros.com/services/investigate): Employee complaint investigation services following ISO/TS 37008 standards
- [Consult](https://www.epspros.com/services/consult): HR consulting for management, HR professionals, in-house counsel
